752:t_2:3.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「$c! We'll fight alongside you too!」

752:t_2:4.en:
$$カガリ$$
「Turn our feelings into your strength too!」

752:t_2:6.en:
$$星刻$$
「Even if we can't stand together on the battlefield, our feelings are with you!」

752:t_2:7.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「That's right! You are our hope!」

752:t_2:8.en:
$$アルベルト$$
「Please! We're counting on you, everyone! I believe in the future too!」

752:t_2:11.en:
$$ナナリー$$
「That's why we aren't afraid!」

752:t_2:12.en:
$$マリナ$$
「As long as you... as long as $c is here.」

752:t_2:16.en:
$$ミラ$$
「I confirm that every $$ＺＯＮＥ$$ is operating normally. $$ラース・バビロン$$'s $$霊子吸収システム$$ is also operating stably.」

752:t_2:17.en:
$$ラクシャータ$$
「Good work, $$ミラ$$. Thanks to your help, Earth's super-dimensional physics has made incredible advances.」

752:t_2:18.en:
$$百目鬼$$
「Everyone on this Earth's feelings are becoming one through the $$レイライン$$s and $$ＺＯＮＥ$$s!」

752:t_2:19.en:
$$ロイド$$
「$$蒼の地球$$ and $$翠の地球$$, the colonies, the Moon, $$火星$$... Anyway, it's everyone.」

752:t_2:20.en:
$$セシル$$
「That draws out Earth's $$次元力|lc$$ and becomes $c's strength!」

752:t_2:21.en:
$$敷島$$
「This is the best we can do!」

752:t_2:22.en:
$$弓$$
「But I'm sure you can do it!」

752:t_2:30.en:
$$ロシウ$$
「You've always opened a path to the future!」

752:t_2:31.en:
$$キノン$$
「So I'm sure you'll do it this time too!」

752:t_2:32.en:
$$リジット$$
「The future of the green and blue planets now rests on your shoulders!」

752:t_2:33.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「We're counting on you! Our hearts are with you too!」

752:t_2:34.en:
$$ベベル$$
「Sis, $$レド$$...! Give it your all!!」

752:t_2:35.en:
$$キヤル$$
「Don't lose, $c! Keep fighting, $$大グレン団$$!」

752:t_2:41.en:
$$つばさ$$
「It's all right, $$静子$$. $c will surely pull through.」

752:t_2:46.en:
$$ナミダ$$
「We'll cheer you on with everything we've got too!」

752:t_2:52.en:
$$サチ子$$
「Big Bro, everyone at the company!」

752:t_2:56.en:
$$梅江$$
「So make sure you come back alive!」

752:t_2:58.en:
$$兵左衛門$$
「Fight to the end with all your strength!」

752:t_2:59.en:
$$梅本$$
「I believe in the power you and your robots create.」

752:t_2:63.en:
$$バニラ$$
「We're counting on you! We're counting on you, $c!」

752:t_2:64.en:
$$ココナ$$
「Don't cheer them on so pathetically!」

752:t_2:65.en:
$$ゴウト$$
「We've come this far, so steel yourselves! We're giving it everything too!」

752:t_2:66.en:
$$キデーラ$$
「Yeah! Spirit quanta, the power of life, whatever it is, take all you want!」

752:t_2:67.en:
$$ポタリア$$
「This is the way we can fight!」

752:t_2:68.en:
$$フィアナ$$
($$キリコ$$... Please... come home...)

752:t_2:74.en:
$$神村$$
「I believe in them with all my heart.」

752:t_2:75.en:
$$大河内$$
「That's right. They're the ones who will carry the future.」

752:t_2:79.en:
$$ベルトーチカ$$
「Humanity is one now.」

752:t_2:80.en:
$$ハヤト$$
「The light in people's hearts will surely illuminate the future.」

752:t_2:81.en:
$$カイ$$
「This should set the times in motion too, assuming there's a future beyond this.」

752:t_2:85.en:
$$サリィ$$
「This power is what humanity gained by overcoming war...」

752:t_2:86.en:
$$レディ$$
「Yes... It is something humanity won with its own hands.」

752:t_2:87.en:
$$マリーメイア$$
「And it is something all people will share.」

752:t_2:93.en:
$$オルバ$$
「I don't like us asking someone else for anything.」

752:t_2:94.en:
$$シャギア$$
「But we have no choice but to acknowledge their strength.」

752:t_2:96.en:
$$シャギア$$
「Heh... Let us entrust this, and our future too, to them.」

752:t_2:102.en:
$$サイアム$$
「The future is already just ahead of us...」

752:t_2:106.en:
$$ソシエ$$
「$$ロラン$$! Earth is such a wonderful place! Hurry back!!」

752:t_2:107.en:
$$ソシエ$$
「If you don't come home, you'll answer to me!」

752:t_2:108.en:
$$キエル$$
「It's all right, $$ソシエ$$. $$ロラン$$ isn't the kind of person who breaks promises.」

752:t_2:110.en:
$$グエン$$
「You believe in them, don't you?」

752:t_2:115.en:
$$エンジェル$$
(The last page of '$$メトロポリス$$'...)

752:t_2:116.en:
$$エンジェル$$
(You're the ones who will fill it.)
